item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"Each `dspy.Predict` stores the provided `Signature` class on `self.signature` without cloning it: `Predict.__init__` assigns `ensure_signature(signature)`, and `ensure_signature` returns an existing signature class unchanged.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"Changing `signature.instructions` mutates the shared signature class in place, because the `instructions` setter writes to `cls.__doc__` and the getter reads instructions back from that class docstring.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"`Signature.with_instructions(...)` is the safe one-off customization path because it creates and returns a new `Signature` class with the same fields and new instructions instead of mutating `cls`; using that returned class as one predictor's `signature` isolates the change.","span_ids":["s1","s4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":58,"end_line":63},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":511,"end_line":518},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":215,"end_line":222},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":269,"end_line":297}]}
